title: fix(plugin-detail,app-shell): a field group's visibleWhen gates its record:details section through the spec's { group } reference (objectui#11630)
body:
Fixes #11630
Clause-②: yes

## What was wrong

An object's `fieldGroups[].visibleWhen` gated the group on the entry form but not on the record detail page. `deriveFieldGroupDetailSections` rebuilt each group as an enumerated section and dropped the predicate that the shared derivation (`deriveFieldGroupLayout`, `@objectstack/spec`) passes through, and `record:details` read none. So the "Pro details" section of the card's reproduction rendered, header included, on a `basic` row.

## Route (patch round 1: route B, seat ruling on the card)

`@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0 `RecordDetailsProps.sections[]` is strict. It declares `group`, the ADR-0085 §5 reference form that inherits a group's members and presentation, `visibleWhen` included. It declares `fields` as bare names, and it refuses `visibleWhen` on an enumerated section. So the fix writes pages in that vocabulary:

- **Synthesizer** (`packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`): `resolveDetailSections`, and through it `buildDefaultDetails` / `buildDefaultTabs` / `buildDefaultPageSchema`, now emit each declared group as `{ group: KEY, columns }`. The trailing ungrouped section lists bare field names. The derivation sits behind one package-internal function, `deriveFieldGroupDetailEntries`. It returns each resolved section with the group's `visibleWhen` carried BESIDE it, never on it. The public `deriveFieldGroupDetailSections` returns exactly what it returned before this card: resolved sections, no predicate.
- **Renderer** (`packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx`): `record:details` resolves a `{ group }` reference against the object's `fieldGroups` and evaluates the group's `visibleWhen` against the bound record. It drops the section, heading and members, when the verdict is FALSE. It does **not** read `visibleWhen` off an enumerated section, a key the spec refuses there.
- **Runtime default page** (`packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`): the console's default record page builds its own section list, so it now writes `{ group: KEY, showBorder: true }` for each declared group. Without that change the card's reproduction path stays ungated, because an enumerated copy cannot carry the predicate. Its ungrouped primary and "More details" sections are unchanged.
- The `record:details` registration's `sections` input description now says a `{ group }` reference inherits the group's `visibleWhen`, and that one written on a section itself is not read.

### One evaluator, the form's

The form renderer gates a `section-divider` row with `resolveFieldRuleState` (`@object-ui/core`) under `usePredicateScope()` (`@object-ui/react`). `record:details` makes the same call with the same three inputs. Both modules are existing peer dependencies of `@object-ui/plugin-detail`: no `plugin-form` dependency and no copy of the evaluator.

- `record`: every declared field seeded to `null`, then the defined values of the bound record, as the form's `ruleRecord` is built. A relation is collapsed to its stored id (`toPredicateRecord`), because the edit form reads its record without `$expand` and this page's record may arrive expanded.
- `previous`: the same row. An edit form binds `previous` to the persisted row, and the row this page shows is the persisted row.
- `scope`: the host predicate scope (`current_user`, `features`, ...).

A predicate that cannot be evaluated SHOWS the section and warns once. That is the form's direction (`VISIBLE_WHEN_FAULTED`, ADR-0137 D3), taken from the shared evaluator rather than restated.

## Consumers of the synthesized sections, and what each does now

| consumer | path | after this PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| console default record page | `RecordDetailView` builds `synthParts.sections` from `deriveFieldGroupDetailSections(objectDef)` and passes them into `buildDefaultPageSchema` | changed: writes `{ group: KEY, showBorder: true }` per group; `RecordContextProvider` gets `objectSchema={objectDef}`, so the reference resolves |
| console page-assignment probe | `RecordDetailView`'s early `buildDefaultPageSchema(objectDef, slots)` | no code change; it only decides whether a page exists |
| Studio page create | `metadata-admin/anchors.ts` `createSeed` stores `buildDefaultPageSchema(objectDef).regions` | no code change; the seed now holds `{ group }` references and parses as `RecordDetailsProps` |
| Studio slotted-page preview | `metadata-admin/previews/PagePreview.tsx` calls `buildDefaultPageSchema(recordSchema, { slots })` | no code change; its `RecordContextProvider` gets `objectSchema={recordSchema}`, so the references resolve |
| authored `{ group }` reference | `record:details` resolves it through `deriveFieldGroupDetailEntries` | now gated by the group's `visibleWhen` |
| `deriveFieldGroupDetailSections` callers | public export | output unchanged from before this card |

Pins that cover them: `RecordDetailView.sectionHeadingsRenderPath-6190` (mounts `RecordDetailView`), `anchors.page-seed`, `PagePreview`, `defaultFieldGroupsPage.sectionHeadings` (real synthesized page through the real registry), and the two new files below.

## Published surface (Clause-②)

The emitted shape changes for grouped objects: BREAKING for code that reads the synthesized sections (the changeset is `minor`, per AGENTS.md §9).

- `buildDefaultPageSchema`, `buildDefaultTabs`, `buildDefaultDetails` and `resolveDetailSections` used to emit each group as an enumerated copy: `name`, `label`, `icon`, `description`, `collapsible`, `defaultCollapsed`, `columns`, and `fields` as rich `{ name, label, type, ... }` descriptors. They now emit `{ group: KEY, columns }`. The ungrouped section's `fields` are bare names. An explicit `sections` option is still returned unchanged.
- `record:details` gates a `{ group }` reference with the group's `visibleWhen`.
- `RecordDetailView` (`@object-ui/app-shell`) writes `{ group: KEY, showBorder: true }` per group.
- Not added: a type member, zod member, registered `inputs` entry, prop or i18n key. `deriveFieldGroupDetailEntries` is exported from its module for the renderer and is not re-exported from the package entry.

Migration (also in the changeset): read a group's heading or members via `deriveFieldGroupDetailSections(def)` instead of off a synthesized section. Replace a stored section copied from an older seed (`{ name: 'pro', label: ..., fields: [...] }`) with `{ group: 'pro' }`; only the reference form inherits the group's `visibleWhen`.

**Spec legality, measured** (installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.6.0, `RecordDetailsProps.safeParse`):

| input | verdict |
| --- | --- |
| `buildDefaultDetails(def).properties` for a grouped object | OK |
| the `record:details` node inside `buildDefaultPageSchema(def)` | OK |
| control: an enumerated section plus `visibleWhen` | `unrecognized_keys @ sections.0 [visibleWhen]` |
| control: an enumerated section with a field object | `invalid_type @ sections.0.fields.0` |

This also retires the round-0 finding that the synthesized grouped sections were refused at every field object.

## Tests

Gates on `75c794c` (route B, after merging `origin/main` at `0abd4f9`), all under the shared verify lock, from the repo root:

- Targeted, six files (the two new files, `buildDefaultPageSchema.test.ts`, `defaultFieldGroupsPage.sectionHeadings`, `recordDetailsInputs.spec-parity`, `buildDefaultPageSchema.strictPayload`): `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 147 passed (147)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/`: `Test Files 238 passed | 1 skipped (239)`, `Tests 2382 passed | 8 skipped (2390)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/`: `Test Files 1001 passed | 1 skipped (1002)`, `Tests 9951 passed | 9 skipped (9960)`.
- `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check`: exit 0. `lint`: exit 0 for both packages, 0 errors.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` was red on `75c794c` (TS2345: `flatMap` inferred its element type from the first return). Fixed in `594b154` and `aeddcd7` by annotating the element type as unknown-valued records, a type-only change.

Rerun on final HEAD `aeddcd7` under the lock: app-shell type-check exit 0; app-shell lint exit 0, 0 errors, with the warning count equal to `75c794c`; the three app-shell consumer pins (`RecordDetailView.sectionHeadingsRenderPath-6190`, `anchors.page-seed`, `PagePreview`): `Tests 15 passed (15)`; the two new files: `Tests 18 passed (18)`. The full plugin-detail and app-shell suites ran on `75c794c`, whose runtime code `aeddcd7` does not change. Unlocked root checks on `594b154`, each exit 0: `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:spec-symbols`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`. On `aeddcd7`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:phantom-deps` and the changeset presence check were rerun, exit 0 each.

`renderers/__tests__/record-details.groupVisibleWhen-11630.test.tsx` renders every case twice on the same row: through `record:details`, fed by `buildDefaultDetails` (now `{ group }` references), and through the entry form renderer (`@object-ui/components` `form`), given the section-divider row `projectSectionDivider` emits for a group, as an edit form of that row. Each leg asserts the form's verdict, the detail page's verdict and the expected verdict on `[basic, pro]`:

| predicate | expected |
| --- | --- |
| envelope `record.kind == 'pro'` (the card) | hidden, shown |
| bare string, same source | hidden, shown |
| no predicate (control) | shown, shown |
| bare identifier `kind == 'pro'` (unbound, so it faults) | shown, shown |
| parse error | shown, shown |
| `record.tier == 'gold'`, a declared field no row carries | hidden, hidden |
| `record.owner == 'u2'`, a lookup that arrives expanded here | hidden, shown |
| `previous.kind == 'pro'` | hidden, shown |
| `'sales_manager' in current_user.positions`, denied then allowed | hidden, shown |

Further legs:

- An authored `{ group: 'pro' }` reference: hidden, shown, on both spellings.
- The runtime default page's `{ group, showBorder }` shape: hidden, shown.
- An enumerated section carrying a spec-refused `visibleWhen`: shown, shown, because it is not read.

Every render reads an ungated anchor first and throws `HARNESS DEAD` before any verdict. `synth/__tests__/buildDefaultPageSchema.groupVisibleWhen-11630.test.ts` pins the emitted references, the absence of `visibleWhen` and field objects on every section the page writes, the two-control legality reading above, and the predicate travelling beside the resolved section.

### Ablation on route B (one-shot, on `75c794c`)

Each mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs`: an anchor that must hit once, a blob change verified on disk, and a restore proven by blob equal to HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`. Afterwards the diff against HEAD was 0 bytes and the two new files passed again (18/18). The red direction was predicted before running.

| mutation | predicted | observed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| drop the gate in `resolveSectionGroup` | 8 gated legs red; 4 controls and 6 synth legs green | 8 failed, 10 passed |
| emit the old enumerated copy instead of `{ group }` | 3 synth shape and legality legs, plus the 6 gated matrix legs fed by `buildDefaultDetails`, red | 9 failed, 9 passed |
| read `visibleWhen` off an enumerated section | only the enumerated-not-read leg red | 1 failed, 17 passed |
| bind `previous` to nothing | only the `previous` leg red | 1 failed, 11 passed |
| skip the relation collapse | only the lookup leg red | 1 failed, 11 passed |
| skip the `null` seed | only the declared-but-absent leg red | 1 failed, 11 passed |

No `HARNESS DEAD` or partial-group error appeared in any ablation run.

**NOT MEASURED: live before/after on a running backend.** Reason: the shared objectstack checkout has no built CLI (`packages/cli/dist` is absent). A backend needs a fresh objectstack worktree plus a full app-showcase closure build, and that build goes through the shared verify lock, which stayed saturated this session. The console path is covered in two halves, not by a live run. The `RecordDetailView` mount pin shows that its references resolve and the group headings render. The runtime-default-page leg shows that the same `{ group, showBorder }` shape is gated.

## Acceptance notes

- The predicate is evaluated against the bound, persisted record, not an unsaved inline-edit draft.
- A page stored from an older Studio seed keeps its enumerated copy of a group and is not gated. The changeset's migration line covers it.
- `RecordDetailView`'s ungrouped primary and "More details" sections still carry rich field descriptors. That page is synthesized at runtime and never stored or parsed, and route B does not need them changed.
- The spec's `deriveFieldGroupLayout` TSDoc calls the section gate fail-closed. The form, and now the detail page, fail open on a faulted predicate. This PR keeps parity with the form; the seat carries that question to the maintainer.
